notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least three artifacts and/or enchantments.
description:
Cast Dockside Extortionist by paying {1}{R}.
When Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least three Treasure tokens.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{R}{W}.
Activate Sword of the Realms' equip ability by paying {1}{W}, attaching it to Dockside Extortionist.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Dockside Extortionist, adding {C}{C}.
When Dockside Extortionist dies, Sword of the Realms triggers, returning Dockside Extortionist from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.name: Halvar, God of Battle // Sword of the Realms
